title: QC-ABOUT-005 — General Manager's Message

QC-ABOUT-005 — General Manager's
Message
FRONTEND — Visitor Display
User Story ID
QC-ABOUT-005 | US-001 | REF:
FR-009
Title
General Manager's Message —
Visitor Display
As a
public website visitor
I want
to access and read the General
Manager's Message on the Qatar Chamber website
So that
I can review the operational
direction and leadership communication from the General Manager
Preconditions:
- The Qatar Chamber website is published and
accessible.
- The General Manager's Message page is published
in the CMS.
Frontend Workflow:
- Public Visitor navigates to Main Menu → About Us → General Manager's Message.
- The page loads with Hero Banner, Page Title ("General Manager's Message"), and breadcrumb (Home > About Us).
- The two-column layout renders: GM portrait image on the left with maroon offset background card and GM name caption (maroon) below; message content on the right.
- The message content renders with a salutation heading (maroon, e.g., "Dear members and visitors,") followed by body paragraphs.
- Below the message body, the signature block renders: avatar/thumbnail, closing text ("Best Regards,"), GM name, and designation in italics (e.g., "Acting General Manager").
- Public Visitor scrolls through, reads the message, and may use hyperlinks where available.
Given the visitor opens the General Manager's Message page
When the page renders
Then
- the system shall display the Hero Banner, Page Title, breadcrumb, and rich text message content as configured.
- the GM portrait image with maroon offset background card and name, title caption.
- the salutation heading shall render in the brand maroon style per the approved Figma design.
- the signature block (avatar, closing text, GM name, designation) shall render below the message body as configured.
- the GM name shall be consistent between the portrait caption and the signature block .
- rich text shall support headings, paragraphs, bullets, and inline links.
- hyperlinks shall be CMS-configurable and follow the approved open behavior.
- Hero Banner and image content shall support alt text for accessibility.
- only published content shall appear on the website.
- the page shall render correctly in both LTR (EN) and RTL (AR) layouts, including mirrored two-column placement.
- the page shall be responsive; on mobile.
Edge Case Scenarios:
- If translation is
missing for the selected language, the system shall fall back to the configured
default language.
Negative Scenarios:
- If the page fails to load, visitor shall see a
standard error page.
- Draft content shall remain visible only in CMS.
Post Condition:
- Visitor can read the General Manager's Message
and access any configured hyperlinks.
BACKEND — Admin CMS Management
User Story ID
QC-ABOUT-005 | US-002 | REF:
FR-009
Title
General Manager's Message — CMS
Management
As a
authorized admin user (Site
Content Editor / Site Content Author)
I want
to create, edit, and publish the
General Manager's Message page content including bilingual text, Hero Banner and GM portrait image
So that
visitors can read the latest
General Manager's Message on the Qatar Chamber website
Preconditions:
- Admin has Site Content Editor or Site Content
Author role in Liferay CMS.
- General Manager's Message page record is
accessible in the CMS.
Administrator Workflow:
- Site Content Editor or Site Content Author logs into Liferay CMS.
- Opens the General Manager's Message page record.
- Creates or updates page title (EN + AR), salutation heading (EN + AR), message content (EN + AR), and hyperlinks where permitted.
- Uploads or replaces the Hero Banner image and sets alt text.
- Uploads or replaces the GM portrait image and enters the GM name caption (EN + AR).
- Updates the signature block: closing text, GM name, designation (EN + AR), and avatar image where applicable.
- Saves content as draft or previews it.
- Publishes the page.
- System saves and displays a Liferay generic success toast message (EN + AR).
Given the admin opens the General Manager's
Message page in CMS
When the admin updates and publishes the content
Then
- the system shall allow the admin to create, edit, preview, publish, and unpublish the page where permitted.
- the system shall allow the admin to manage the GM portrait, name caption, salutation heading and signature block.
- the GM name entered once shall drive both the portrait caption and the signature block to prevent spelling inconsistencies.
- Site Content Author shall be able to view and update assigned page content where permitted.
- the system shall validate image format (JPG, PNG, SVG), image size (max 2 MB) before save or publish.
- the system shall support draft → preview → publish → unpublish lifecycle.
- the system shall display a Liferay generic success toast message after each successful action (EN + AR).
- only published content shall appear on the website; draft content remains visible only in CMS.
Edge Case Scenarios:
- If Arabic title is missing and Arabic is
enabled: "Arabic title is required." العنوان العربي مطلوب.
- If image size exceeds 2 MB: "Image size
must not exceed 2 MB." يجب ألا يتجاوز حجم الصورة 2 ميغابايت.
Negative Scenarios:
- If page title is empty: "Page title is
required." عنوان الصفحة مطلوب.
- If a hyperlink URL is invalid: "Please
enter a valid URL." يرجى إدخال رابط صالح.
- If the admin lacks permission: "Access
Denied. You do not have permission to perform this action." تم رفض الوصول.
ليس لديك صلاحية لتنفيذ هذا الإجراء.
Post Condition:
- General Manager's Message is published and
visible. Audit log records the change.

Permissions:
- Site Content Editor (Site Role): Create, Edit,
View, Preview, Publish, Unpublish page content where permitted.
- Site Content Author (Site Role): View and update
assigned page content where permitted.
- Public Visitor: View published page content.
Business Rules:
- Draft content remains visible only inside CMS.
- Only published content is visible on website.
Admin Toast Messages: Use Liferay Generic
Messages (EN + AR).
